note: Shared Word web topics for every level. Each topic lists words from any level; a level shows only its own words (topics with fewer than 3 are hidden unless they are a word's only home). sentences: level -> a sentence using only that level's and earlier words; a level without its own sentence uses the nearest lower one. Order and groups here are the order and groups on screen.

1.zh: 你好！谢谢你，再见！
1.en: Hello! Thank you, goodbye!

2.zh: 不好意思，请问洗手间在哪儿？
2.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

1.zh: 他是我的朋友，她是我的同学，我们都很好。
1.en: He is my friend, she is my classmate, and we are all well.

2.zh: 我自己做饭，大家都说好吃。
2.en: I cook for myself, and everyone says it is tasty.

1.zh: 这个很好，那个太贵了。
1.en: This one is good; that one is too expensive.

2.zh: 今天这里人这么多！
2.en: There are so many people here today!

1.zh: 你叫什么名字？你住在哪儿？
1.en: What is your name? Where do you live?

2.zh: 你今天为什么不去学校？
2.en: Why aren't you going to school today?

1.zh: 我家有三口人，他八岁，她十岁。
1.en: There are three people in my family; he is eight and she is ten.

2.zh: 这个手机一万块，太贵了。
2.en: This phone costs ten thousand yuan; that is too expensive.

1.zh: 你有多少钱？我有一点儿。
1.en: How much money do you have? I have a little.

2.zh: 每个人都有一些书。
2.en: Everyone has some books.

1.zh: 我买了三本书、两件衣服和一个苹果。
1.en: I bought three books, two items of clothing and an apple.

2.zh: 这位老师有两条狗和一只猫。
2.en: This teacher has two dogs and a cat.

1.zh: 我叫小明，认识你很高兴。
1.en: My name is Xiaoming; nice to meet you.

2.zh: 我来介绍一下，这是我的朋友，他叫小明。
2.en: Let me introduce my friend; his name is Xiaoming.

1.zh: 这个人是我的朋友，那个小朋友是他的孩子。
1.en: This person is my friend, and that child is his child.

2.zh: 这个男孩儿是我的同学，那个女孩儿是我的朋友。
2.en: This boy is my classmate and that girl is my friend.

1.zh: 我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、姐姐和我。
1.en: There are five people in my family: dad, mom, older brother, older sister and me.

2.zh: 我爷爷奶奶住在我家，他们身体很好。
2.en: My grandparents live in our home; they are in good health.

1.zh: 我女儿八岁，她是小学生。
1.en: My daughter is eight; she is a primary-school student.

2.zh: 我小时候住在中国，从小就喜欢吃饺子。
2.en: I lived in China when I was little, and I have liked dumplings since I was a child.

1.zh: 我在公司工作，今天很忙。
1.en: I work at a company, and I am busy today.

2.zh: 我哥哥是医生，今天他上班很忙。
2.en: My older brother is a doctor, and he is busy at work today.

1.zh: 今天是四月五日，明天是星期天。
1.en: Today is April 5th, and tomorrow is Sunday.

2.zh: 下个星期五是我的生日。
2.en: Next Friday is my birthday.

1.zh: 现在几点？现在是七点半。
1.en: What time is it? It is half past seven.

2.zh: 请等一会儿，现在是下午三点十分。
2.en: Please wait a moment; it is ten past three in the afternoon.

1.zh: 你在做什么？我正在看电视。
1.en: What are you doing? I am watching TV.

2.zh: 我已经吃饭了，你经常在这里吃饭吗？
2.en: I have already eaten; do you often eat here?

topics.name: Food and meals
topics.cta: Use these in the café conversation

1.zh: 我早饭吃面包，午饭吃米饭，晚饭吃饺子。
1.en: I eat bread for breakfast, rice for lunch and dumplings for dinner.

2.zh: 这家饭馆的鱼很好吃，我们去吃吧。
2.en: The fish at this restaurant is very tasty; let us go and eat.

topics.name: Drinks
topics.cta: Use these in the café conversation

1.zh: 我喝茶，他喝牛奶，你喝水吗？
1.en: I drink tea, he drinks milk; do you drink water?

2.zh: 我喝咖啡，她喝奶茶，他们喝红茶。
2.en: I drink coffee, she drinks milk tea and they drink black tea.

topics.name: Money and shopping
topics.cta: Use these when you ask a price

1.zh: 这件衣服多少钱？太贵了，我想买便宜的。
1.en: How much is this piece of clothing? It is too expensive; I want to buy a cheaper one.

2.zh: 商场里的东西很贵，超市的便宜一点儿。
2.en: Things in the mall are expensive; the supermarket's are a little cheaper.

1.zh: 这件衣服很好看，你想穿吗？
1.en: This piece of clothing is pretty; do you want to wear it?

2.zh: 这条裤子和这个包都很好看。
2.en: These trousers and this bag are both pretty.

topics.name: Places around town
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 我去商店买东西，也去书店看书。
1.en: I go to the shop to buy things, and I also go to the bookstore to read.

2.zh: 机场离酒店很远，我们坐地铁去。
2.en: The airport is far from the hotel; we go by subway.

topics.name: Directions and positions
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 你的书在桌子上，我的手机在这里。
1.en: Your book is on the table, and my phone is here.

2.zh: 学校在左边，医院在右边，超市在前面。
2.en: The school is on the left, the hospital is on the right, and the supermarket is ahead.

1.zh: 我今天去学校，明天回家。
1.en: I go to school today and go home tomorrow.

2.zh: 你进来吧，我出去一下就回来。
2.en: Come in; I will go out for a moment and be right back.

topics.name: Roads and distance
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 学校离我家很近，走路十分钟就到了。
1.en: The school is very near my home; it takes ten minutes on foot.

2.zh: 学校离我家很近，走路十分钟就到了。
2.en: The school is very near my home; it takes ten minutes on foot.

topics.name: Transport and tickets
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 我坐出租车去，你坐火车去。
1.en: I go by taxi, and you go by train.

2.zh: 我坐地铁去机场，你坐公交车去车站。
2.en: I take the subway to the airport, and you take the bus to the station.

1.zh: 我想去中国玩，你呢？
1.en: I want to go and have fun in China; what about you?

2.zh: 我想出国旅游，已经买了机票。
2.en: I want to travel abroad, and I have already bought the plane ticket.

1.zh: 我家有三个房间，桌子和椅子在大房间里。
1.en: My home has three rooms; the table and chairs are in the big room.

2.zh: 我家在三楼，洗手间在门口旁边。
2.en: My home is on the third floor, and the restroom is next to the doorway.

1.zh: 我是大学生，我哥哥是中学生。
1.en: I am a university student, and my older brother is a middle-school student.

2.zh: 明天开学，我要去教室找老师。
2.en: School starts tomorrow; I will go to the classroom to find my teacher.

1.zh: 我学习汉语，我有很多问题。
1.en: I study Chinese, and I have many questions.

2.zh: 明天考试，这些题我都懂，没有问题。
2.en: The exam is tomorrow; I understand all these questions, so there is no problem.

1.zh: 我学汉语，会写一些汉字。
1.en: I study Chinese and can write some characters.

2.zh: 我每天读书、写汉字，也学新词。
2.en: Every day I read, write characters and learn new words.

1.zh: 我的手机在桌子上，请打电话给我。
1.en: My phone is on the table; please call me.

2.zh: 我每天上网看电影，网上的东西很多。
2.en: I go online to watch movies every day; there is a lot online.

1.zh: 我早上起床，晚上睡觉，中午吃饭。
1.en: I get up in the morning, go to bed in the evening and eat at noon.

2.zh: 我早上起床，洗手，穿衣服，吃早饭。
2.en: In the morning I get up, wash my hands, get dressed and eat breakfast.

1.zh: 今天天气很冷，在下雨，明天会下雪。
1.en: The weather is cold today and it is raining; it will snow tomorrow.

2.zh: 昨天是阴天，今天是晴天。
2.en: Yesterday was cloudy, and today is sunny.

1.zh: 我家有一只狗和一只猫。
1.en: My family has a dog and a cat.

2.zh: 那只鸟很漂亮，我很喜欢这些花。
2.en: That bird is very pretty, and I like these flowers a lot.

1.zh: 我喜欢白色和绿色，不喜欢黑色。
1.en: I like white and green, and I do not like black.

2.zh: 我喜欢白色和绿色，不喜欢黑色。
2.en: I like white and green, and I do not like black.

1.zh: 你喜欢玩什么？
1.en: What do you like to play?

2.zh: 我的爱好是画画和跳舞，很有意思。
2.en: My hobbies are drawing and dancing, and they are very interesting.

1.zh: 我喜欢看电影，也喜欢听歌。
1.en: I like watching movies, and I also like listening to songs.

2.zh: 我喜欢看电影，也喜欢听歌。
2.en: I like watching movies, and I also like listening to songs.

1.zh: 我喜欢运动，也喜欢踢足球和打篮球。
1.en: I like sports, and I also like playing soccer and basketball.

2.zh: 我喜欢运动，也喜欢踢足球和打篮球。
2.en: I like sports, and I also like playing soccer and basketball.

1.zh: 他生病了，我们去医院看医生。
1.en: He is ill, so we go to the hospital to see a doctor.

2.zh: 我头疼，身体不舒服，要吃药。
2.en: I have a headache and do not feel well; I need to take medicine.

1.zh: 我很高兴，你也很高兴吗？
1.en: I am very happy; are you happy too?

2.zh: 今天我很快乐，也有一点儿累。
2.en: I am very happy today, and a little tired too.

1.zh: 我知道，我觉得这个很好，我想买。
1.en: I know; I think this one is good, and I want to buy it.

2.zh: 我希望你记得，不要忘了，我懂你的意思。
2.en: I hope you remember; do not forget; I understand what you mean.

1.zh: 我在做饭，你可以开电视吗？
1.en: I am cooking; can you turn on the TV?

2.zh: 请帮我拿一下书，我来洗杯子。
2.en: Please help me take the book; I will wash the cups.

1.zh: 我看见他了，他说话，我听见了。
1.en: I saw him; he spoke, and I heard it.

2.zh: 请告诉我，你问他了吗？
2.en: Please tell me: did you ask him?

1.zh: 请坐。
1.en: Please sit down.

2.zh: 他在那儿跑步，我站在这里看。
2.en: He is running over there, and I am standing here watching.

1.zh: 请等一下，我做完就开始。
1.en: Please wait a moment; I will start as soon as I finish.

2.zh: 请等一下，我做完就开始。
2.en: Please wait a moment; I will start as soon as I finish.

1.zh: 这个大，那个小，这里的人很多。
1.en: This one is big, that one is small, and there are many people here.

2.zh: 他跑得快，我走得慢，路很长。
2.en: He runs fast, I walk slowly, and the road is long.

1.zh: 这个菜很好吃，这本书很新。
1.en: This dish is very tasty, and this book is new.

2.zh: 这个不错，那个坏了。
2.en: This one is not bad; that one is broken.

1.zh: 这些东西是我的，这件事我知道。
1.en: These things are mine, and I know about this matter.

2.zh: 这件事情我已经知道了，不是问题。
2.en: I already know about this matter, and it is not a problem.

1.zh: 我是学生，我有一个哥哥，他在家。
1.en: I am a student, I have an older brother, and he is at home.

2.zh: 我是学生，我有一个哥哥，他在家。
2.en: I am a student, I have an older brother, and he is at home.

1.zh: 我想去中国，我会说一点儿汉语，我能去吗？
1.en: I want to go to China; I can speak a little Chinese; may I go?

2.zh: 他今天可能不来，老师让他在家休息。
2.en: He may not come today; the teacher told him to rest at home.

1.zh: 我不想去，我没有时间，你不要问了。
1.en: I do not want to go, and I have no time; you should not ask again.

2.zh: 别等我，我不去了。
2.en: Do not wait for me; I am not going.

1.zh: 请给我水，我想问你一个问题。
1.en: Please give me some water; I would like to ask you a question.

2.zh: 他帮我拿书，还告诉我怎么学汉语。
2.en: He helps me carry my books and also tells me how to study Chinese.

2.zh: 他比我高，他跑得最快。
2.en: He is taller than me, and he runs the fastest.

1.zh: 今天太热了，我非常想喝水。
1.en: It is too hot today; I really want a drink of water.

2.zh: 这家饭馆的鱼最好吃。
2.en: This restaurant's fish is the tastiest.

1.zh: 我和你都是学生，他也是。
1.en: You and I are both students, and he is too.

2.zh: 我们一起去，大家都去，你也去吗？
2.en: We go together, everyone is going; are you going too?

1.zh: 因为今天太冷，所以我不想去，但是我还是去了。
1.en: It was too cold today, so I did not want to go, but I went anyway.

2.zh: 因为今天太冷，所以我不想去，但是我还是去了。
2.en: It was too cold today, so I did not want to go, but I went anyway.

1.zh: 我给你一个苹果，你对我很好。
1.en: I give you an apple; you are very good to me.

2.zh: 我从家走路来学校，他比我快。
2.en: I walk to school from home; he is faster than me.

1.zh: 你好吗？我很好，你呢？我们去吧。
1.en: How are you? I am fine; and you? Let us go.

2.zh: 你去过中国吗？我去过，那里很大啊！
2.en: Have you been to China? I have; it is very big there!
